display_long_description:
OHS in Automotive: VR Simulator for Occupational Health and Safety in the Automotive Sector.

This innovative simulator combines realistic 3D environments and immersive scenarios to teach occupational health and safety in automotive workshops. Safely practice the selection and use of 22 types of PPE, with 35 work orders tailored to areas such as mechanics, electric vehicles, bodywork, welding, and painting. Experience the consequences of your decisions in a safe way and enhance your skills with dynamic exercises designed to evaluate your knowledge in real time.

Benefits for educators:
Reduce risks in practical training, facilitate real-time evaluations, and enjoy the flexibility to teach anytime and anywhere with an accessible catalog of teaching resources.

Benefits for students:
Learn in a safe and realistic environment, boost your motivation and retention through "learning by doing," and practice in scenarios simulating real work situations.

The simulator records results, allows detailed progress tracking, and is available in Spanish, Basque, and English. Compatible with multiple devices and designed for minimal space requirements, it is an ideal tool to transform learning in VET. Request your free demo and access our quick guide to implement virtual reality in the classroom. Take your training to the next level!
